source_refs.note: Brittle Substance: a main subheading of 5.5 Elastic deformation, plastic deformation and elastic limit, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 98-99.

blocks.text: The substances which break just after the elastic limit is reached, are known as brittle substances. For example, glass and high carbon steel are brittle. Moreover, Beryllium, Bismuth, Chromium are also brittle metals.

blocks.title: Example 5.1
blocks.problem: A steel wire 12 mm in diameter is fastened to a log and is then pulled by tractor. The length of steel wire between the log and the tractor is 11 m. A force of 10,000 N is required to pull the log. Calculate the stress in the wire.

blocks.title: Brain Teaser!
blocks.text: Why does a ship made of heavy steel float on water, while a small rock sink?
